purpose: Predeclare the only permitted formal qualification path if the already-authorized Q5.2 geometry-transport development run selects exactly one candidate. This protocol does not authorize formal outcomes by itself.

candidate_handoff.source: candidate_selected from the frozen development aggregate only
candidate_handoff.if_null: formal qualification is forbidden and the geometry-transport family terminates
candidate_handoff.if_selected: the selected candidate definition is inherited byte-for-byte from the frozen development implementation; no weight clipping, exponent, density bandwidth, graph fraction, field bandwidth, response transformation, threshold, role, or candidate combination may change

fixed_method.ttf_m: inherits the already-qualified Q5/Q5.1 TTF-M result and is not a formal candidate dimension

precision_gate.ttf_c_formal_pass: every type-I cell upper95 <= 0.10 AND every power cell lower95 >= 0.80
precision_gate.joint_q5_2_pass: inherited TTF_M_Q5_1_pass == true AND TTF-C formal pass == true

terminal_rules.formal_pass: qualifies only the selected TTF-C geometry-transport estimator on the declared finite heterogeneous synthetic family; Q5 and Q5.1 remain failed historical estimators
terminal_rules.formal_fail: candidate is immutable formal FAIL; no same-family threshold, clipping, density bandwidth, graph, field bandwidth, response, or null retuning; any successor requires a newly named mechanism and fresh development family
terminal_rules.empirical_next_gate_after_pass: independent application-specific observation-support and measurement contract before any ecological outcome is opened
